title: Occupancy and Residency Certification — Standing Date of a Facility-Confirmed Contact
content:
A contact confirmed in a facility letter on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile is numbered by reference to its **standing date**, which depends on how long after the stated contact date the letter was received:

| Letter received, counted in calendar days after the contact date it states | Standing date |
|---|---|
| more than 30 and no more than 120 days after | the date the letter was received |
| more than 120 days after | the handling date |
| 30 days or fewer after, or received before the contact date it states | the contact date the letter states |

The letter read is the accepted facility letter about the primary borrower received most recently.

## Boundaries (hypothetical day counts)

- Received on the 30th day after the contact date: the contact date stands.
- Received on the 31st day: the receipt date stands.
- Received on the 120th day: the receipt date stands; on the 121st day, the handling date.
